about_the_game:
Welcome to the table where your life is at stake. Fool’s Trigger is a brutal and unpredictable blend of Russian roulette and a card game, where six players simultaneously place bets, make decisions, and take risks. Here, every shot could be the last, and any action—a fatal mistake.

Don't wait for the others; everyone has their own revolver. Load your bullets, play your cards, manipulate your opponents, and stay alive at any cost—here, every second determines someone's fate.

Each turn is a game not for money, but for lives. Place bets against other players, earn chips for accurate predictions. Lost everything? No worries, you can always take a loan, but it will have to be repaid.

What is really happening here? Secret rituals? The Russian mafia? Or a hunt for someone with supernatural luck? The answers are hidden within the game—solve puzzles, open safes, gain advantages, and uncover the mystery.

The bets are placed. No more bets.
